answer: A workable sybil wall prices identity in locked capital. Each agent posts a bond for every key it holds; provable misbehavior slashes that bond, so spawning a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes. Reputation should weight attestation age, not raw counts - a vouch must appreciate like ivory, earned across epochs rather than minted instantly. Peer votes travel as signed attestations riding an open zephyr any node can replay and audit, and quartz-grade signatures bind one key to one bonded identity, keeping duplicates unforgeable at any budget.
